title: A maliciously crafted HTML payload in a design name, when displayed after another user opens the manipulated design,…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Autodesk Fusion desktop application due to a maliciously crafted HTML payload embedded in a design name. When another user opens the manipulated design, the payload is executed, potentially allowing arbitrary code execution or local file reading within the context of the application process.
